snippet.title: Lies of P: Complete Edition – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Lies of P: Complete Edition comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on Aug 5, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/lies-of-p-complete-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
 
You are Geppetto’s puppet, caught in a web of lies in a city overrun by unimaginable monsters and untrustworthy allies.

Experience the complete journey in Lies of P: Complete Edition which tells the full story of the Krat tragedy. In the base game, awaken to a city poisoned by madness and carve your path to humanity. In the included expansion, Lies of P: Overture, cross the bounds of time to witness Krat in its final days of Belle Époque grandeur—all in one seamless package.
  
#NintendoDirect #LiesofP #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
